fair_value.method: Blend of 2027E EV/EBITDA (~$700M x 6.0x, ~$150M net debt by mid-2027 -> $38.6), 2027E P/E ($3.90 x 10x -> $39) and a NAV/DCF cross-check at a mid-cycle $5.00/lb long-term copper deck with Furnas risked (~$30); weights 0.40/0.35/0.25 give ~$36.5/share, which is roughly the current price.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: 2027E copper 76 kt (Caraiba ~42 + Tucuma ~34, haircut vs 67.5-90 kt CMD ranges for the guidance-miss history) at $6.20/lb realized with C1 $2.30/lb -> ~$630M copper margin; Xavantina 50 koz x ($4,200-$1,300) = ~$145M; less ~$75M G&A/exploration -> EBITDA ~$700M. 6.0x (mid-tier single-country copper producers 5-7x; discounted for Brazil/execution) = $4.2B EV; net debt ~$150M mid-2027 (from $453M at Q2-26 after ~$300M FCF); ~105M diluted shares.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: 2027E EPS ~$3.90: EBITDA $700M - D&A ~$150M - interest ~$40M = $510M pretax, ~20% tax (SUDENE incentives) -> ~$408M / 105M shares. 10x multiple (copper miner mid-cycle 9-12x on spot-ish deck). Cross-check: H1-26 adj EPS $1.51; Scotiabank 2027E EPS $4.63 (May 2026).

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: NAV-style DCF: long-term copper $5.00/lb, gold $3,500/oz, 8% real discount rate; operating assets unlevered FCF ~$380M/yr for ~10 yrs -> ~$2.55B; Furnas (PEA 108 kt CuEq/yr, $0.24/lb CuEq cost, FID 2029) risked at ~$0.9B; corporate costs -$0.3B; net debt -$0.45B -> ~$2.7B equity (~$26/sh) and 1.15x P/NAV typical for producers in a firm copper tape -> ~$30.

bear.story: Copper retraces from ~$6.70/lb record toward $4.75-5.00 as LME stocks build and tariff/China demand fade; Ero again misses (2026 at low end, 2027 ~70 kt), stronger BRL and inflation push C1 up; Brazil election volatility. EBITDA ~$450M at 5x -> ~$20.

base.story: Copper stays ~$5.75-6.50/lb, Tucuma reaches 4 Mtpa run-rate after filtration upgrades, 2027 production ~75-80 kt at ~$2.30/lb C1, revolver repaid and shareholder returns begin; Furnas PFS in progress. Stock tracks fair value in mid/high-$30s.

bull.story: Copper extends to $7-7.50/lb (Citi-style deficit case), Ero finally beats guidance (~85 kt), net cash by mid-2027 with buyback/dividend, Furnas drilling/PFS de-risks a second growth leg; EBITDA ~$1B at 6x -> high $50s.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$23 (roughly -40%, EV ~$2.6B, ~3.7x base 2027E EBITDA) the market would be pricing either a sustained copper collapse below ~$4.75/lb or a fundamental operating failure (Tucuma filtration/throughput not fixed, Caraiba grade/throughput shortfall, or a Brazil fiscal/royalty shock) that breaks the deleveraging and FCF inflection thesis, rather than normal 60%-vol noise.

catalysts.event: Brazil general election (first round Oct 4, possible runoff late Oct) - BRL and country-risk volatility
Q3 2026 production results (H2-weighted copper, Xavantina gold ramp)
Q3 2026 financial results; revolver paydown progress
Tucuma tailings filtration expansion completion targeting 4 Mtpa run-rate by year-end; Furnas Phase 3 drilling complete
FY2026 production vs 67.5-77.5 kt guidance and 2027 guidance release; possible capital return framework once revolver repaid
LME copper price path (record ~$14,875/t on 2026-09-10, now ~$14,600/t)

key_uncertainties: Copper price: spot ~$6.70/lb is near records; bank 2027 forecasts range ~$4.90 (GS $10,750/t) to $6.80/lb (Citi bull) - earnings leverage is very high
Execution: three years of guidance misses; Tucuma throughput/filtration and Caraiba grade sequencing
Brazil: BRL strength and inflation raising C1 (~$0.10/lb) once hedges roll off; October 2026 election; fiscal/royalty policy
Capital allocation after deleveraging (returns vs Furnas capex ahead of 2029 FID)
Xavantina gold ramp (at low end of 40-50 koz guidance, AISC $2,881/oz in Q2)
reasoning: ERO is Ero Copper (Brazil: Caraiba, Tucuma copper; Xavantina gold; Furnas project). Stock doubled in a year on copper reaching records (~$6.70/lb, LME ~$14,600/t) and a cash-flow inflection: Q2-26 adj EBITDA $144M, OCF $138M, adj EPS $0.83, net debt down to $453M (0.8x), 2026 flagged as the last major capex year. 2026 copper guidance 67.5-77.5 kt maintained, C1 $2.15-2.35/lb; CMD (Sept 14) laid out 2026-28 ranges of Caraiba 35-50 kt, Tucuma 32.5-40 kt, Xavantina 40-60 koz, and Furnas (108 kt CuEq, PFS 2027, FID 2029). My 2027 model (76 kt, $6.20/lb realized, mean-reverting slightly below spot) gives EBITDA ~$700M, EPS ~$3.90, FCF ~$3.40/sh (~9% yield). EV/EBITDA and P/E give ~$39; a mid-cycle-deck NAV gives ~$30; blended fair value ~$36.5, i.e. the stock is roughly fairly priced on a near-spot deck and expensive on mid-cycle copper. Sell-side is split (consensus ~C$48 = ~US$34, high C$56 = ~US$40; Goldman downgraded in April on valuation and guidance misses; CIBC/NBF raised targets in late Sept; 9 of 17 Hold). So I centre the distribution slightly below spot (median ~$37) with no strong drift. For width I use ~47% annualised log-vol: below the 64% realised (which included a +100% run and extreme copper moves) but far above large-cap base rates because ERO is a levered, single-country copper equity whose earnings move ~2-3x copper. Scenarios bear $20 (25%) / base $38 (50%) / bull $58 (25%) give a mean ~$38.5 consistent with a right-skewed lognormal; I fattened the left tail slightly for a copper-price mean reversion from record highs. Research limited to web sources (no options data used).
